description:
爱琅医疗销售实习生项目
项目概览
渴望在校提前扎根医疗行业、近距离接触临床一线、积累外企实战经验？想依托国际化平台、把课堂专业知识落地到真实医患服务与市场推广中？爱琅医疗销售实习生项目将为你提供机会！
本项目为爱琅人才储备核心计划，全周期360°陪伴成长，实习期间你将获得：
- 行业认知升级：了解介入医疗专业产品知识，接触国内外医疗市场格局与行业资讯，建立完整行业思维；
- 一线实战历练：跟随资深客户经理走访医院临床科室、参与学术会议搭建与落地，直面医护专家，积累高质量人脉；
- 简历镀金背书：外企介入医疗器械实习经历，大幅提升后续求职竞争力；
- 转正绿色通道：实习优异者有机会留用，锁定外企医疗器械销售稳定职业赛道，为毕业就业提前铺路。 职位描述
我们期待这样的你：
1. 本科及以上学历，医学/药学/护理学/生物医学工程等相关专业；
2. 对医疗行业有兴趣，乐于人际沟通、擅长换位思考，对临床客户维护、市场推广有热情；
3. 具备良好抗压与团队协作能力，做事细致主动；
4. 2027届优先，可提供每周≥3天出勤。
日常实习工作内容：
1. 协助大客户经理完成医院临床客户拜访，建立良好客勤关系；
2. 协助并配合大客户经理组织学术推广、产品宣讲等市场活动；
3. 了解市场同类产品情况及动态，收集市场信息并及时反馈。 投递方式
感兴趣的同学简历发送至：vndr_iTalent.AMDC@argonmedical.com
邮件主题：【应聘销售实习生+地区】
（可选城市：北京/上海/广州/杭州/南京/济南/郑州/重庆） 公司介绍
Argon Medical Devices 爱琅医疗 | 全球介入治疗领域标杆外企
源自美国，创立于1972年，拥有超50年介入器械研发与商业化经验；全球员工超1000人，业务遍布全球100+国家，深耕肿瘤介入&血管介入黄金赛道，多款核心产品稳居全球细分市场TOP3。
爱琅中国2018年落地上海总部，现有员工百余人，业务全覆盖全国31省市及港澳台地区，长期与国内三甲医院临床科室深度合作，平台成熟、体系完善，是医药专业学生入行医疗器械行业的优质选择。
企业文化
使命：在爱琅医疗，我们通过创新、制造和提供一流的医疗设备和优质服务，来改善患者和护理人员的生活
愿景：爱琅医疗致力于用最前沿的技术和最高质量的产品，携手医生为患者带去最有保障的关爱
价值观：正直诚信、彼此尊重、快速响应、以人为本、注重结果

majors: 机械设计制造及其自动化

description:
2027年毕业同学
工科专业：机械，机电，电子，电气，材料，汽车，新能源汽车，化学。
工作职责：
1、协助工程师进行汽车电子电气相关测试，主要包括电性能，可靠性，环境测试，可独立带项目，熟悉标准ISO 16750，VW80000，SMTC 3 800 001，常见的样件可以独立完成，如带link功能的各种车灯，带有控制盒功能的雷达，摄像头，线束，开关等；
2、学习使用各种检测设备和仪器，了解电子电器实验室每款设备的参数及测试能力；如示波器，万用表，可编程电源，电子负载，绝缘电压仪，Kegsight数据采集器等；
3、对测试重复率较高的测试项目可独立撰写原始记录单及独立完成项目，如VW80000：E-01~E-15，E-18，E-20， M-01， K-01~K-05， K-09， K-14；
4、样品领取，样品信息确认，根据测试标准和测试方法确认样品是否符合要求；
5、学习标准解读，确认测试条件，根据客户要求，制定测试参数，检测方法，检测流程，跟进检测项目；
6、学习原始数据检测分析，完成原始记录，检测报告编辑，提交上传系统；
7、测试中遇到的问题能及时沟通，解决，反馈，确保项目可以及时有效完成；
8、负责检测设备点检，维护和保持工作环境清洁；
9、能够及时，高效的完成工程师分配的测试项目；
10、与公司价值观保持一致，协助实验室负责人完成其他工作。

跨境电商选品上架部分

2. 竞品与数据追踪：协助采集两大平台竞品的销售数据、定价策略、用户评价及促销活动信息；借助平台数据工具或 Excel 等，初步分析产品销量、排名波动原因，筛选具备毛利与竞争力的潜力选品方向。

4. 选品后跟进：跟踪新选品上架后的初期销售数据，收集消费者反馈，协助整理选品效果复盘资料，为调整选品策略提供基础支持。
5. 资料整理归档：负责选品相关数据、供应商信息、市场调研报告等资料的分类整理，维护选品信息库，保障信息可追溯。
职位要求
任职要求
1. 本科及以上在校生，专业不限，国际贸易、电子商务、日语、小语种（泰语 / 印尼语等）专业优先
2. 熟练运用EXCEL等办公软件，掌握VLOOKUP，if，sumif等基本函数和数透
3 对跨境电商有兴趣，了解亚马逊、Shopee 平台基础规则，有相关平台购物或初步运营经验者优先
4. 具备较强的责任心和团队协作意识，思维灵活，能快速响应市场变化，接受跨境电商行业的工作节奏
5. 工作积极主动，细心且有责任心，对电商运营感兴趣的优先考虑
6. 实习期至少4个月以上 ，每周至少4天在职时长，能长期实习优先

渴望在校提前扎根医疗行业、近距离接触临床一线、积累外企实战经验？想依托国际化平台、把课堂专业知识落地到真实医患服务与市场推广中？爱琅医疗销售实习生项目将为你提供机会！

3. 了解市场同类产品情况及动态，收集市场信息并及时反馈。 公司介绍

源自美国，创立于1972年，拥有超50年介入器械研发与商业化经验；全球员工超1000人，业务遍布全球100+国家，深耕肿瘤介入&血管介入黄金赛道，多款核心产品稳居全球细分市场TOP3。

"爱琅医疗(Argon)成立于美国，是全球领先的介入治疗产品生产商及营销商。爱琅总部位于德克萨斯州弗里斯科市，全球拥有900多名员工，在100多个国家开展业务。公司目前在德克萨斯州、纽约州、伊利诺斯州等多地设生产基地。

在未来，爱琅中国会继续与国内外合作伙伴通力合作，打造以患者为中心的商业模式，形成爱琅、经销商与医护三线联动，持续为患者提供最专业的产品，守护生生不息的梦想，共同为患者创造美好的未来。" 企业文化

title: Intern Demo Experience & Applied AI
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
The Team:
Celonis Demo Engineering is the creative and technical engine of our Go-To-Market strategy. We are on a high-stakes mission to build the Next-Gen Demo Factory — a world where AI agents and LLMs handle the heavy lifting of demo creation, democratizing demo excellence for 1,000+ GTM colleagues. We create experiences that kick off our customers' journey with Celonis and help them visualize the future on our platform.
To build these experiences, we collaborate with Value Engineering, Product Management, Product Marketing, Enablement, and Industry teams — and we push the limits of the Celonis platform to bring our vision to life.
The Role:
As a Demo Engineering Intern, you'll sit at the intersection of technology, storytelling, and business strategy — and you'll contribute to our Next-Gen Demo Factory mission, where AI agents and smart workflows are transforming how we build and deliver demos at scale. You'll help prototype agentic tools, configure demos on the Celonis platform, and experiment with AI-assisted storytelling. But this isn't just a technical role: you'll also develop a broad understanding of the real-world business problems Celonis solves across industries like manufacturing, retail, and financial services — giving you a rare window into both the technical and commercial sides of an enterprise AI company.
The work you’ll do:
Explore the AI-powered demo frontier: Support the build of AI-assisted workflows — prompt-to-demo experiments, automated data story generation, and smart screen configuration.
Learn the business landscape: Work across industries and functions — from Accounts Payable to Supply Chain — to understand the problems Celonis solves and translate them into compelling, executive-ready stories.
Partner with Value Engineering, Product Marketing, and Industry teams to develop demos that resonate with both technical and business audiences.
Contribute to demo assets across formats: C-level executive demos, event showcases, product feature demos, and AI use case prototypes.
Help identify manual tasks in the demo lifecycle and propose or prototype automation ideas to reduce effort.
Assist with demo QA, environment maintenance, and responding to internal user questions.
The qualifications you need:
A curiosity about both business and technology — you're as interested in understanding why a process breaks down as you are in the tools that fix it.
Some exposure to SQL and/or Python (coursework counts) — you don't need to be a developer, but comfort with data is a plus.
The ability to take a complex idea and tell a clear, compelling story around it.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-moving environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
A degree in progress in Management & Technology, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent.

title: Technical Support Specialist Intern - French speaking
description:
About Formlabs
A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build.
Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem.
That’s what we do.
At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, and NASA.
Our Services team keeps those printers running. We help direct customers, distributors and resellers across EMEA resolve technical issues, investigate machine errors, analyse printer logs and get the most out of their Formlabs ecosystem.
Your Impact:
As our Technical Support Specialist Intern, you’ll be at the heart of our technology. You’ll diagnose machine errors, analyze printer logs and work hands-on with hardware, firmware, software and materials to find the root cause of complex issues. This is a highly technical role where your engineering mindset and language knowledge are put to work every day.
What makes the role special is the combination of deep technical problem-solving and real human connection. Our customers are mainly engineers, dentists, jewelers and manufacturers who rely on Formlabs printers every day.
The Job:
Respond to technical and product inquiries from direct customers, distributors and resellers in the EMEA region by email, chat and phone.
Troubleshoot printer, material and software issues, guiding customers step by step to a fix.
Review printer logs and error reports to find the root cause of problems.
Document every case clearly in our ticketing system so the team can pick up where you left off.
Escalate complex cases to senior specialists and our global engineering team, and follow them through to resolution.
Help resellers deliver great service to their own customers.
Get hands-on with Formlabs printers in the office to reproduce issues and test solutions.
About You:
Currently studying engineering.
Fluency in French and English (at least C1 level).
Technically curious and comfortable learning how hardware and software work — don't worry, we'll provide all the product training you need.
A natural problem-solver with a structured, step-by-step approach to troubleshooting.
Patient, friendly and a great listener, comfortable speaking with customers on the phone.
Able to work at least 20 hours / week
Bonus: a passion for 3D printing or hands-on experience with a 3D printer.
We Offer:
Catered lunch at the office 3 days / week
Free 3D prints
An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues
Hands-on technical training on the full Formlabs product ecosystem.
Real experience supporting customers across the EMEA region alongside an expert team.
You don’t need to check every box to apply for a role. If you love working with hardware, spending time with smart people, solving hard problems, and winning, we want to hear from you.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Security Engineer Intern
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions
This is a 12-week internship during summer 2027.
Coinbase’s Application Security team is rethinking how offensive security works. We use frontier AI models to find vulnerabilities at scale, red team our own AI systems, and automate the parts of security work that don't need a human. As an intern, you'll join that effort on a scoped project and see your work used in real security decisions.
What you'll do:
Build and test tooling that uses frontier AI models to surface vulnerabilities across Coinbase’s products, working alongside senior engineers on design and review.
Help red team internal AI systems - probing for prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, and tool misuse, then documenting what you find and how to fix it.
Automate pieces of the vulnerability triage, validation and remediation workflows so the bug bounty, vulnerability response pipelines move faster and become AI native.
Reproduce and verify reported vulnerabilities across common classes (OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25), and write findings that engineering partners can act on.
Practice responsible AI use: keep a human in the loop, measure whether your tooling actually improves speed or quality, and be honest when it doesn’t.
Required Skills and Experience:
Currently pursuing a degree or certificate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or a related area discipline.
Proficiency in Python or Go and strong software development skills shown through coursework, personal projects and internships.
Curiosity about LLMs and a willingness to experiment: you’ve at least tried building with a model API and thought about how it could be manipulated.
Experience with security tooling such as Burp Suite, Semgrep, fuzzing frameworks, or Metasploit.
Hands-on exploration of prompt injection or jailbreak techniques.
Clear communication, especially in writing - you can explain a technical finding to someone who has to fix it.
Experience with GitHub and AWS.

description:

A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build.
Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem.
That’s what we do.
At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, and NASA.
Events are a critical way we connect with our users and showcase our products, with over 20 tradeshows and company events across EMEA each year.
Your Impact:
As our Events Logistics Intern, you'll be the hands-on support behind our EMEA tradeshow program. Working closely with our EMEA Events Logistics Coordinator, you'll look after the physical side of our events: our storage space, inventory, demo printers, display parts and booth materials, making sure everything is ordered, tested, packed and ready to ship on time. Alongside day-to-day tasks, you'll own longer-term projects to make our storage and logistics more efficient. This 6-month role is ideal for someone practical and organized who enjoys hands-on work and wants real experience in event logistics.
The Job:
Keep our event storage space clean, organized and clearly labelled.
Track and maintain the inventory of event materials: demo printers, 3D printed display parts, signage, swag, booth hardware, supplies and consumables.
Order and maintain our standard sample and display parts, and coordinate reprints when parts are damaged or worn.
Test demo printers and equipment before and after each show to make sure they are working and show-ready.
Keep a maintenance and testing log, and coordinate repairs or replacements with internal teams.
Prepare printers, accessories and materials for shipping, and check them on return.
Support the Events Coordinator with shipment preparation, pickups and returns with logistics partners.
Provide on-site support at selected events, mainly during setup and dismantling (occasional travel within EMEA).
Projects you'll own
Over the 6 months, you'll take ownership of longer-term projects that improve how we run our logistics. These may include:
Storage & inventory efficiency: audit our storage, introduce a clear labelling and tracking system, clear out unused items and propose ways to save space and costs.
Demo printer health program: set up a standard check-up and testing routine for our printer fleet, so every printer arrives at a show ready to run.
3D Printed display part library: review the condition of our display parts, organize the library and plan replacements.
Standard event kits: build ready-to-ship kits and packing templates for recurring show types, so each event is faster to prepare.
You:
Currently studying logistics, supply chain, event management, engineering, business or a related field.
Fluency in English.
Available to work at least 20 hours / week - (40 hours/week would be preferable)
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a methodical approach to tracking stock and checking equipment.
Technically curious and comfortable learning to operate and test hardware.
Confident with Google Workspace (especially Sheets).
Proactive and reliable, able to work independently and flag issues early.
Some flexibility to work outside normal hours occasionally (e.g. before shipments or show setup days).
Must be able to lift up to 25 kg.
We Offer:
Catered lunch at the office 3 days per week
Free 3D prints
An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues
You will gain hands-on experience running the logistics behind a full EMEA tradeshow program.
Your own projects with visible impact on how our team works.

title: Product Management Intern (MSP), Winter 2027
description:
Internship Duration: January - May 2027
About Rubrik
Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. For more information, please visit www.rubrik.com and follow @rubrikInc on X (formerly Twitter) and Rubrik on LinkedIn.
About Team
The Product Management team at Rubrik drives the company’s vision forward, ensuring we continue to secure the world’s Data, AI, and Identity by delivering on our market-leading platform to address our customers’ most challenging data management & security needs. Our Product Managers are responsible for guiding multidisciplinary teams towards the goal of shipping high-quality products on time. We wear multiple hats throughout the different stages in the product lifecycle and set the vision for our growing family of products. As advocates for both our users and our business, Product Managers balance varied perspectives and empower their teams to do great work.
About Role
Rubrik's Managed Service Provider (MSP) business is a key strategic lever for the company. MSPs build data protection and cyber recovery services on top of vendor platforms like Rubrik and deliver them to their end customer. Getting the MSP experience right is both a product challenge and a business strategy challenge.
As a Product Management Intern on the MSP team, you will report to the Director of Product Management, Platform, driving forward-looking initiatives that shape roadmap direction and long-term product strategy. You'll take ownership of high-impact projects at the intersection of product strategy, cross-functional execution, and customer insight — working across engineering, design, sales, and customer-facing teams with direct exposure to MSP customers and their real-world operational challenges.
About Rubrik’s Internship Program
Rubrik offers interns an opportunity to make an impact from day one. Our interns work on challenging projects, where their contributions help solve real-world problems related to personal privacy, business continuity, and digital safety. Interns learn from the best in the industry, building connections with senior team members who support their development through 1:1 mentorship. Alongside the meaningful work, interns are fully immersed in Rubrik's inclusive community through social events, networking opportunities, professional development workshops, and volunteering events.
During the internship, you’ll have access to:
Meaningful projects: the opportunity to translate your education into hands-on professional experience through rigorous, yet rewarding work
Growth and development: take advantage of extensive growth opportunities through mentoring, job shadowing, workshops, lunch n’ learns, and hands-on project work that supports both your personal and professional development.
A dedicated manager & mentor: a team that will provide you with guidance and support regularly
Intern events: the opportunity to participate in networking events, volunteering opportunities, and social events
Other perks: Access to free mental health services, lunch stipend, optional 401K benefits, company-wide intern presentations, intern swag, and more!
What we do matters. Join us and unleash your potential!
What You’ll Do
We're looking for curious interns who want to be entrusted with real responsibility and who embrace the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
Analyze MSP operational workflows to identify high-impact product opportunities.
Conduct competitive and adjacent market analysis to assess positioning and differentiation within the MSP landscape.
Develop structured problem statements, opportunity assessments, and product requirements documents (PRDs), translating customer needs into actionable product direction.
Partner with Engineering, Design, and GTM teams to evaluate technical feasibility, define tradeoffs, and present recommendations to product leadership.
Engage with MSP customers and internal stakeholders (Sales, Support, Customer Success) to validate assumptions and ground your work in real customer pain points.
Must Have Qualifications:
Educational Background: Currently pursuing an MBA or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline.
Graduation Date: Expected completion in December 2027 or Spring 2028.
Availability: Availability to work full-time between January – May 7, 2027, at our headquarters in Palo Alto, CA.
Skills & Interests:
Technical Skills & Experience:
Experience analyzing complex technical systems, enterprise software, or cloud infrastructure through coursework, internships, research, or prior work experience.
Comfortable engaging in technical discussions around system architecture, multi-tenancy models, APIs, and platform design; programming experience is a bonus.
Prior exposure to product management, consulting, B2B SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or managed services is a plus.
Strong ability to break down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems, identify core tradeoffs, and develop structured recommendations.
Interest & Domain Knowledge:
Demonstrated interest in enterprise SaaS, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, or the managed services ecosystem - with curiosity about how service providers build businesses on top of vendor platforms.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis and recommendations to technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive audiences.
Comfort operating in ambiguity - shaping the playbook, not following one.

title: AMEA Implementations Intern
description:
The Company You’ll Join
Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work.
For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.
The Problems You'll Solve
In this role, you will become an equity expert and use that knowledge to implement our clients onto the Carta software, setting them up for long-term success. You will directly interact with clients, managing their implementation projects from post-sale data collection to sending out securities to stakeholders. As the first service provider post-sale, you will establish strong customer relationships and inspire long-term loyalty by guiding them through the implementation process and providing an exceptional customer experience.
You will also need to feel comfortable working with data, business systems, and developing training & enablement content for our customers. This role is a fit for people that are hungry to learn and who can think creatively to find software solutions to both equity and user problems. Successful Implementation Managers embrace change and constantly seek ways to better their process and their team.
Our Delivery team members have grown to become some of the strongest contributors in our company due to their thorough understanding of our software, customers, and the business value we deliver. Ideal candidates will have a strong passion for financial services, building customer relationships, project delivery, and analytical problem solving. In this role, you will:
Problem-solve, all day every day!
Support new clients and their law firms in “on-boarding” them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s capitalization table and securities on Carta & add-on products (e.g. CTC)
Manage complex datasets with high integrity and accountability; executing complex cap tables with minimal errors and maximal accuracy
Maintain the quality of clients’ data throughout the on-boarding process
Set customers up for success with value-based adoption & engagement, using every KOC as an opportunity to understand the customer’s problems & communicate clearly how Carta can help solve them
Understanding each customer’s ‘why Carta?’, and ensuring the onboarding process encapsulates Carta’s unique value propositions: source-of-truth accuracy, administrative time & cost savings, growth scalability, compliance & risk management, audit efficiency, employee engagement/retention, etc.
Migrate Clients Data to Carta’s Onboarding Spreadsheet in Excel, leveraging AI & Automation tools for scalable efficiency
Coordinate and manage inputs needed from both the clients and their law firms in a timely manner; ensuring you take multiple communications channels to achieve appropriate resolution on this data (email, calls, zooms, in-person meetings)
Train clients on how to use Carta Software – perform product demos, walk-throughs, recordings as necessary to educate customers on how to use Carta Software
Create quality customer-facing content to support education & enablement as required
Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process; you influence these optimisations regularly and share them with the broader team to elevate ways-of-working
Proactively manage your clients to appropriate Activation dates, sending them live on time or early and improve your Time-to-Value month over month
Establish clear multi-phase project timelines and strictly adhere to them, ensuring timely project delivery and effectively managing all internal and client expectations related to the project schedule.
Take accountability for setting customers up for success, with early focus on achieving a ‘Green’ health status through sustainable stakeholder engagement & adoption
Give your clients resources to appropriate teams post go-live
Have the ability to work cross-functionally with teams; collaborating with Sales & Support & CS to elevate the end-to-end customer experience at all times.
Embrace the ‘voice of the customer’ in sharing any risks or challenges with your peers for proactive account management.
Work closely with product, engineering and our internal implementations leaders to collaborate on strategic initiatives, improve the on-boarding experience for our customers, leveraging global best practices
Communicate effectively with cross-functional peers; you take strong accountability for the critical role you play in impacting customer health by setting customers up for success in their first 90-day Carta experience
Build collaborative relationships with cross-functional peers (incl. Product, Engineering, Tech Leads, Legal), taking the time to connect with them on calls/zooms/in-person meetings as required to achieve successful outcomes for your customers
Proactively engage with trainings & enablement sessions to ensure you are resourced to provide the best customer experience
Proactively share customer updates internally/externally:
Updating clear notes in SFDC Implementation projects for ALL customers
Take initiative on process optimisations, to continuously improve cross-functional collaboration & customer experiences at scale.
Apply (and experiment with) new AI & automation tools to resolve the challenges/obstacles in your day-to-day jobs-to-be-done
The Impact You'll Have

title: Product Design (Mechanical Engineering) Co-Op
description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About Samsara Hardware Engineering:
Samsara's hardware systems bridge the gap between the rapidly evolving world of physical operations and our cloud platform that enables our customers to increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations which power the global economy. The hardware footprint is big – we build ultra-low power sensors, ruggedized asset trackers, vehicle ADAS systems with AI/ML, telematics systems, and rackmount video inspection with AI/ML, with more to come in the future. We leverage myriad technologies including injection molding, sheet metal, precision optics, gaskets and seals, thermal materials, adhesives, and more. Our challenges range from ingress sealing, thermal management, structural analysis, and drop and vibration survival to material selection, design for manufacturability, tooling optimization, and cost reduction, all in products built to survive extreme environments.
About the role:
We're looking for a Product Design (Mechanical Engineering) co-op to join our team. In the day-to-day, you will be responsible for working on the mechanical aspects of the design of products based on thorough feasibility, design, and cost studies encompassing enclosure architecture, materials selection, thermal management, sealing, etc. We have a tremendous amount of telemetry and access to customers that help guide our design process. You will work directly with our customers to ensure we lead the industry with our product design. We run a collaborative process working closely with Product Management, EE, FW, EPM, NPI, and Hardware leadership to make excellent tradeoffs and choices. Throughout this process, you'll share your expertise with other engineers. The US and Taiwan PD teams are supported by the Supply Chain team, laboratories, JDM design resources, and a growing supply base. You will work closely with these internal and external partners to achieve our objectives.
This role will be held at our San Francisco office. Co-ops are required to be in the office Tuesdays to Thursdays and remote work days on Mondays and Fridays. As part of the co-op program, we do provide relocation and housing support for the duration of the co-op. To be eligible for this role, you must be attending a university that supports full-time work as part of a 6-month co-op OR attend a university that will allow you to take 2 quarters or one semester off to work a co-op. Please do not apply if you are unable to commit to the full duration of this co-op. We are looking for this co-op to join us from January - June 2027. At this time, we are not accepting first-year co-op students. Ideally, this student is in their junior year of school as an undergraduate student and has previous internship and/or co-op experience.
You should apply if:
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.
In this role, you will:
Contribute to shipping successful product lines.
Conduct research: Stay informed of the latest materials, manufacturing processes, and mechanical technologies from top suppliers and manufacturing partners.
Know the system: Evaluate system feature tradeoffs and create the system specifications for development with product management and cross-functional engineering teams.
Prototype: Build proof-of-concept models using 3D printing, CNC machining, or quick-turn fabrication for evaluating concepts or jump-starting product development.
Design: Take a concept from industrial design intent through detailed CAD, part and assembly design, and production drawings, spanning enclosures, wiring harnesses and cable assemblies, and product packaging; either on your own or navigate the process with JDM resources.
Test: Create a validation plan for each phase of the product development through PVT and characterize the full mechanical system for ingress protection, drop, shock, vibration, thermal, and environmental performance.
Get hands-on: Install, evaluate, and troubleshoot our products on real vehicles and industrial equipment to understand mounting, cable routing, and real-world use conditions.

title: Product Management Intern (MSP), Summer 2027
description:
About Rubrik
Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. For more information, please visit www.rubrik.com and follow @rubrikInc on X (formerly Twitter) and Rubrik on LinkedIn.
About Team
The Product Management team at Rubrik drives the company’s vision forward, ensuring we continue to secure the world’s Data, AI, and Identity by delivering on our market-leading platform to address our customers’ most challenging data management & security needs. Our Product Managers are responsible for guiding multidisciplinary teams towards the goal of shipping high-quality products on time. We wear multiple hats throughout the different stages in the product lifecycle and set the vision for our growing family of products. As advocates for both our users and our business, Product Managers balance varied perspectives and empower their teams to do great work.
About Role
Rubrik's Managed Service Provider (MSP) business is a key strategic lever for the company. MSPs build data protection and cyber recovery services on top of vendor platforms like Rubrik and deliver them to their end customer. Getting the MSP experience right is both a product challenge and a business strategy challenge.
As a Product Management Intern on the MSP team, you will report to the Director of Product Management, Platform, driving forward-looking initiatives that shape roadmap direction and long-term product strategy. You'll take ownership of high-impact projects at the intersection of product strategy, cross-functional execution, and customer insight — working across engineering, design, sales, and customer-facing teams with direct exposure to MSP customers and their real-world operational challenges.
About Rubrik’s Internship Program
Rubrik offers interns an opportunity to make an impact from day one. Our interns work on challenging projects, where their contributions help solve real-world problems related to personal privacy, business continuity, and digital safety. Interns learn from the best in the industry, building connections with senior team members who support their development through 1:1 mentorship. Alongside the meaningful work, interns are fully immersed in Rubrik's inclusive community through social events, networking opportunities, professional development workshops, and volunteering events.
During the internship, you’ll have access to:
Meaningful projects: the opportunity to translate your education into hands-on professional experience through rigorous, yet rewarding work
Growth and development: take advantage of extensive growth opportunities through mentoring, job shadowing, workshops, lunch n’ learns, and hands-on project work that supports both your personal and professional development.
A dedicated manager & mentor: a team that will provide you with guidance and support regularly
Intern events: the opportunity to participate in networking events, volunteering opportunities, and social events
Other perks: Access to free mental health services, lunch stipend, optional 401K benefits, company-wide intern presentations, intern swag, and more!
What we do matters. Join us and unleash your potential!
What You’ll Do
We're looking for curious interns who want to be entrusted with real responsibility and who embrace the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
Analyze MSP operational workflows to identify high-impact product opportunities.
Conduct competitive and adjacent market analysis to assess positioning and differentiation within the MSP landscape.
Develop structured problem statements, opportunity assessments, and product requirements documents (PRDs), translating customer needs into actionable product direction.
Partner with Engineering, Design, and GTM teams to evaluate technical feasibility, define tradeoffs, and present recommendations to product leadership.
Engage with MSP customers and internal stakeholders (Sales, Support, Customer Success) to validate assumptions and ground your work in real customer pain points.
Must Have Qualifications:
Educational Background: Currently pursuing an MBA or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline.
Graduation Date: Expected completion in December 2027 or Spring 2028.
Availability: Ability to commit full-time to a 12-week internship program at HQ in our Palo Alto, CA Office.
Skills & Interests:
Technical Skills & Experience:
Experience analyzing complex technical systems, enterprise software, or cloud infrastructure through coursework, internships, research, or prior work experience.
Comfortable engaging in technical discussions around system architecture, multi-tenancy models, APIs, and platform design; programming experience is a bonus.
Prior exposure to product management, consulting, B2B SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or managed services is a plus.
Strong ability to break down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems, identify core tradeoffs, and develop structured recommendations.
Interest & Domain Knowledge:
Demonstrated interest in enterprise SaaS, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, or the managed services ecosystem - with curiosity about how service providers build businesses on top of vendor platforms.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis and recommendations to technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive audiences.
Comfort operating in ambiguity - shaping the playbook, not following one.

title: Anti-Cheat Engineering Intern (Masters/PhD) - Summer 2027
description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is passionate about protecting the integrity of multiplayer games and creating a fair experience for players. We work across low-level systems, software protection, and security research to help protect the legitimacy of players’ games.
As an Anti-Cheat Engineering Intern, you’ll work with experienced Vanguard engineers on a summer research project exploring how agentic AI is changing the effectiveness of software obfuscation and virtualization. With mentorship from the team, you’ll use and improve research harnesses that iteratively challenge code-protection techniques, measure the boundaries of AI-assisted reverse engineering, and investigate methods for making protected code more resilient to AI analysis. Work with Anti-Cheat engineers to scope and complete a bounded research project focused on AI-assisted analysis of obfuscated and virtualized code.

Design and run experiments that measure where AI systems succeed, struggle, or fail when reasoning about protected binaries.
Research and evaluate techniques that make software obfuscation and virtualization more resilient to AI-assisted reverse engineering.
Reproduce and validate results, documenting experimental methods, evidence, limitations, and potential defensive implications.
Contribute improvements to shared research tools and workflows, and present progress and findings to engineers and technical partners.

Currently enrolled in a Masters or Doctoral program in the following fields: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related graduate degree program.
Experience programming in C or C++, demonstrated through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects.
Experience with agentic AI tools or harnesses used to automate iterative workflows such as code generation, testing, analysis, or evaluation.
Foundational understanding and relevant coursework in operating systems, computer architecture, compilers, and software security.
Available to work full-time hours for the 12-week program.
Minimum GPA of 2.5.

Graduating in the 2028 calendar year.
Exposure to reverse engineering, binary analysis, code obfuscation, software virtualization, or related security techniques through coursework or hands-on projects.
Experience with Python, scripting, Git, testing, or building repeatable research and evaluation tools.
Familiarity with program-analysis techniques; interest in Windows internals, game security, or software protection is a plus.

You’ll be supported by your team as you learn to build reliable, well-documented solutions.

Collaborate with machine learning engineers, data scientists, software engineers, and product partners on player- or developer-focused projects.
Prepare, clean, and explore datasets for machine learning and data-powered applications.
Implement feature engineering, modeling, and evaluation approaches under the guidance of experienced team members.

title: Strategic Sourcing Intern
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions
TL;DR: This is a 12-week summer 2027 internship on the Tech Sourcing team in Coinbase's Source to Pay (S2P) group, covering software, SaaS, AI, and cloud spend. You'll run analysis projects that turn vendor and renewal data into clear recommendations, and support live sourcing work.
The Source to Pay (S2P) team manages Coinbase's full third-party lifecycle, including strategic sourcing, third-party risk management, procurement-to-pay, and travel and expense. We serve as the primary point of contact for vendors across every category, partnering with cross-functional teams to keep processes clear, efficient, and compliant. Tech Sourcing manages non-human-powered spend: software, SaaS contracts, AI, and cloud. This is a hands-on internship where you'll contribute to real operational work that helps Coinbase scale safely and sustainably.
What You'll Do
Lead a SaaS optimization review: find overlapping tools, spend, renewal dates, and usage, then recommend consolidation or right-sizing.
Build renewal readiness briefs for selected upcoming renewals, covering owners, notice deadlines, spend, usage, and open questions.
Research vendor pricing: compare pricing models, usage units, commitments, and overage exposure across several usage scenarios.
Support live sourcing work, including vendor research, quote comparisons, meeting notes, and follow-ups.
Work with the BPO team to find process delays and test practical fixes.
Support RFP and RFQ development and proposal evaluation, and keep desktop procedures and internal documentation accurate.
Required Skills & Experience
Currently pursuing a degree in finance, business, legal studies, or a related analytical field
Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment
Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and deliver on commitments
Analytical mindset with the ability to dissect problems, analyze data, and make data-driven recommendations
Genuine interest in Coinbase's mission and the future of digital assets
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality

title: Animation Art Intern - Summer 2027
description:
As an Animation Artist Intern at Riot, you will bring champions and characters to life through classic animation principles and body mechanics. You will create high quality animations for a diverse and rapidly growing universe, including bipeds, quadrupeds, and creatures. A great reel will showcase a variety of body types, a diverse selection of action oriented game-related animation, and a strong foundation in the principles of animation, including weight, anticipation, and impact. Also working to expand our current content pipeline, you will collaborate with designers and artists to develop new features and technologies. Your craft expertise will breathe life into iconic and beloved characters for players.
In your application, you will select which product you prefer to apply for:
Teamfight Tactics
As an Animation Artist Intern on Teamfight Tactics, you will animate a large variety of things, ranging from champions (old and new), creatures, and even props! Your animations will have to consider how to synthesize both animation principles and the needs of strict gameplay requirements. Throughout development you will be hand-keying/editing animations in Maya, learning about League’s proprietary game engine, and implementing assets within the Unreal Game Engine. Throughout the internship you will have an onboarding partner and a team supporting you through our set development.
League of Legends
As an Animation Artist Intern on League, you will focus on champion animation. You will collaborate with animators on character lore, their motivations, and incorporate their core identity with project requirements to create impactful character performances. Your animations will be hand keyed in Maya using classic animation principles. You will also be responsible for implementation within our proprietary game engine. Throughout the process you will have an onboarding partner and a mentor to guide you through our development process.
Responsibilities:
Create high quality animations for a diverse and expanding universe, including bipeds, quadrupeds, and monsters
Help develop new features and technologies to expand the content pipeline
Collaborate with designers and artists to create animation assets that fulfill the requirements of the project’s game and visual design
Recognize areas of opportunity and help other animators level up to AAA-title-standards
Consistently meet project deadlines in a timely manner without compromising artistic integrity
Balance craft and product feedback with a strong empathy and focus on player value
Consistently communicate by proactively collaborating, directing next steps, and providing clear goals and outcomes to your team
Required Qualifications:
Currently enrolled in a college, university or non degree program
Available to work full-time hours for 10-12 weeks
Authorized to work in the U.S.
Experience with action and combat based animations showcasing locomotion cycles for characters and creatures of diverse shape and size (bipeds, quadrupeds, etc.)
Experience with Maya
Desired Qualifications:
Gaming specific animations through professional or personal work
Experience w/ Unreal Engine and Animation Blueprints

title: Motion Graphics Art Intern - Summer 2027
description:
As a Motion Graphics Artist Intern at Riot, you'll take the player experience to the next level by creating high-quality motion graphics for our gameplay and systems. Your technical skill for motion and compositing will breathe life into the game, transforming static scenes into powerful moments for players. You will collaborate with other artists and designers to establish how assets and UI elements will respond, transition, and increase player immersion.
In your application, you will select which product you prefer to apply to:
League of Legends
As a Motion Graphics Artist Intern on League of Legends, you’ll help bring player-facing UI and product experiences to life across in-game and around-game features. Working alongside motion artists and a multidisciplinary team, you’ll explore how motion can make League’s interfaces feel clear, responsive, and unmistakably part of the game. You’ll create motion studies and UI animatics from visual designs using tools such as After Effects and Spine. With guidance from the team, you’ll help translate approved concepts into real-time experiences in League’s proprietary game engine, balancing visual quality, clarity, and performance while contributing a fresh perspective to League.
Teamfight Tactics
As a Motion Graphics Artist on Teamfight Tactics, you will contribute to in-game and around-game aspects of Teamfight Tactics's UI. You will craft animatics, design eye-catching transitions / interactive states, and visualize full motion user flows in a variety of tools like After Effects, Spine, and Unreal Engine. You will work under guidance of the Motion Graphics craft lead to translate designs into real-time executions by working directly in our game engine. Performance and optimization are top of mind as you push for the highest visual quality.

Create UI animatics out of static visual designs, following the Teamfight Tactics and League of Legends quality, style and motion conventions
Work closely with the Visual Design lead and UI team to support in and around-game features

Collaborate with a team of Motion Graphics Artists, UX, Audio, Visual Design and Engineering experts to design + bring new UI to life

Experience with VFX authoring tools (Trapcode or Niagara)

title: Operations Intern
description:
Why join us
Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
The Brex Internship Program
Throughout this 1–2 year program, you'll be placed within one of our G&A teams, learning about areas such as risk management, finance, automation, and data analysis. You'll contribute to critical process improvements and developments, implementing our processes while leveraging AI to streamline workflows and enhance decision-making.
You'll challenge the status quo and improve cross-team communication and efficiency. We believe in a founder mindset — and this program is designed to show you how you can take ownership of your growth. About Samsara Hardware Engineering:
Samsara's hardware systems bridge the gap between the rapidly evolving world of physical operations and our cloud platform that enables our customers to increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations which power the global economy. The hardware footprint is big – we build ultra-low power sensors, ruggedized asset trackers, vehicle ADAS systems with AI/ML, telematics systems, and rackmount video inspection with AI/Ml, with more to come in the future. About Rubrik
Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. The Rubrik SE Philosophy
At many companies, a SE is a demo-bot. At Rubrik, SEs are strategic influencers. We don't just answer technical questions, we shape the required capabilities a deal comes down to. Rubrik offers interns an opportunity to make an impact from day one. Our interns work on challenging projects, where their contributions help solve real-world problems related to personal privacy, business continuity, and digital safety. What we do matters. Join us and unleash your potential!

Phase 2 – Your AI Project (Weeks 5–7): Plan, build, and internally present the AI project you'll carry into your capstone.

title: Software Engineering Internship - San Francisco
description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:
At Samsara, interns can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, an intern may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.
On the mobile side, an intern could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments.
Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.
Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged.
You should apply if…
You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.
You want to build for scale. You'll work on technology that powers physical operations at a scale most engineers never experience.
You believe customers are more than a number. Our engineers are deeply invested in our customers and the daily problems they face. They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next. You’ll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with success and product teams, and use metrics to ensure your work translates into real outcomes.
You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.
You're drawn to hard problems and own them end to end. You dig into complexity, research it thoroughly, and find the simplest solution that works - then see it through, holding yourself to a high standard along the way.
You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.
You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.

description:
About Stripe
Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.
Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. title: Ground Systems Engineering Intern Summer 2027
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB
Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.
As a Grounds Systems Engineering Intern based at Rocket Lab’s site in Middle River, Maryland you will have the opportunity to support the team as they design, build, and implement large tooling, fixtures, and custom lift equipment to support prototype and production of Neutron. The Ground Support Equipment engineering team designs and manufactures production, test, and transport equipment in support of Neutron build and operation.
WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO
As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within the department to apply your knowledge and grow your skills both technically and professionally
Work with a fast-paced group of professionals to apply engineering and industry concepts to solve real challenges
Attend frequent 1:1’s with mentors and supervisors to facilitate success and learning while providing progress updates
Enjoy tech talks and network with other interns and employees through social and professional events
YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS
Ideal candidates will thrive in ambiguity and are excited to work in small, high-performing teams that are focused on continued learning and growth. Success in this position will be measured by the knowledge and experience you bring to the role, your ability to lead development projects without supervision, and your ability to successfully collaborate across teams to deliver results.
Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s, master's or doctorate degree program in an engineering discipline such as Manufacturing, Mechanical, Mechatronics or related discipline and have at least one semester of school remaining post internship
GPA of 3.0 or above
3+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable)
THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE
GPA of 3.5 or above
6+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable)
Experience with Solidworks, SiemensNX, Creo, Catia
Experience working with hand tools
Familiar with structural analysis
Familiar with assembling mechanical structures
Computer-aided design and manufacturing (CAD/ CAM) experience
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Able to work full-time, on-site for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning May or June 2027
COMPENSATION AND OTHER BENEFITS
Pay Rate MD: $25.00 USD Hourly
You may be eligible for a stipend to subsidize relocation costs
Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Employees may also receive company equity and access to a robust benefits package including: top tier medical HMO, PPO & a 100% company-sponsored medical HSA plan option, dental and vision coverage, 3 weeks paid vacation and 5 days sick leave per year, 11 paid holidays per year, flexible spending and dependent care savings accounts, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and access to a 401(k) retirement plan with company match. Other perks include: discounted employee stock purchase program, and free snacks/drinks onsite.
Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.
Base Pay Range (MD Only)
$25—$25 USD
WHAT TO EXPECT
We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.
Important information:
FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:
To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.
Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. title: Sales Development Representative, Internship
description:
Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.
About the Internship Program
The Enterprise Development Program is Verkada's accelerated training program designed to fast-track high-potential individuals into successful sales professionals. As an SDR Intern, you'll gain hands-on experience in a dynamic sales environment, learning the fundamentals of tech sales and preparing for a potential full-time role post-graduation.
What You'll Do
Prospect, qualify, and follow up on leads to generate sales opportunities.
Educate potential customers on Verkada's product offerings and value propositions.
Collaborate with Account Executives to schedule and prepare for sales meetings.
Utilize CRM and sales enablement tools to track and manage leads.
Participate in sales training sessions and workshops to develop sales skills.
Contribute to team goals and initiatives, providing support where needed.
What You Bring
Currently a junior pursuing a Bachelor's degree, with at least one more semester remaining after the internship.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Self-motivated with a desire to learn and grow in a sales career.
Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
Comfortable engaging with professionals in a business setting.
Previous experience in customer-facing roles is a plus but not required.
Why Verkada
Gain practical experience in a high-growth tech company.
Receive mentorship and training from experienced sales professionals.
Opportunity to transition into a full-time sales role upon graduation.
Access to a collaborative and inclusive company culture.
Competitive compensation and benefits package.
US Intern Employee Benefits
At Verkada, we’re committed to supporting the health, well-being, and personal growth of our interns. Our comprehensive benefits and perks are designed to promote a balanced and rewarding internship experience. Highlights include:
After 90 days of active employment, interns are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance. We cover 100% of employee premiums under at least one medical plan and 80% of dependent premiums
Time off to rest and recharge through personal sick time and volunteer time off to support causes you care about
Healthy lunches, snacks, and coffee provided daily
Wellness/fitness benefits
Commuter benefits
Additional Information
You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.
Pay Disclosure
At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate’s skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. This estimate can vary based on the factors described above, so the actual starting base pay may be above or below this range. Base pay is also just one component of Verkada’s total rewards package. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).
Estimated Hourly Pay Range
$25—$25 USD
Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer
As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.
Your application will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

title: Marketing Intern
description:
The Company You’ll Join
Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work.
For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.
The Team You'll Work With
Carta is looking for a Marketing Intern to join our Singapore team between January to June 2027.
Carta opened its Singapore office in 2021, and since then, has been building a world-class team to support the startup and investor ecosystem across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Africa.
The Marketing Intern will report up to Carta’s Head of Marketing for APAC & MEA, and get the chance to work firsthand on a range of projects, including marketing campaigns, website optimization, marketing analytics, event support and more. This role will give you the opportunity to try out the different realms of marketing and gain the necessary skill sets to jumpstart your career in B2B tech.
The Problem You'll Solve
Campaigns: Work with the demand generation leads to launch campaigns across the region, and A/B test and optimize lead generation efforts across online and offline channels
Content & PR: Partner with the regional team to localize blog articles to the region, edit bylines, craft organic social media content and develop customer case studies to increase brand awareness
Events: Support on digital & physical marketing collateral ideation and design (presentation decks, swag) as well as provide on-the-ground support for Virtual Events & physical events
Other ad-hoc tasks as assigned
The Impact You will Have
As a Marketing Intern at Carta, you will be an integral part of growing the marketing function in this region. You will drive demand in the market and help oversee Carta’s growth in APAC & MEA.
About You
Studying Bachelors Degree in a relevant field (business, marketing)
Previous internship or work experience in marketing would be preferred
Desire to learn and work in a fast-paced environment
Excellent time management and organizational skills
Interest in B2B Marketing as well as the startup space
Nice to have:
Experience with marketing and sales platforms (such as Salesforce, Marketo, Figma, Google Analytics, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads)
Proficiencies with Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite (GSuite)
Knowledge of the startup and venture capital ecosystem
At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.
Disclosures:
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.
Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details.
For information on our data privacy policies, see Privacy, CA Candidate Privacy, and Brazil Transparency Report.
Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com or @carta-external.com domain. Report any contact from unapproved domains to security@carta.com.

title: PhD Machine Learning Engineer, Intern
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
What you’ll do
About the internship
Stripe's Applied ML, Data Science, Risk, and Payments organizations are excited to offer PhD machine learning engineering internships for the summer of 2027. This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to critical projects that directly enhance Stripe's suite of products, focusing on areas such as foundation models used for dozens of tasks e.g. fraud detection, enhanced support, and predicting user behavior.
As an intern, you'll tackle challenging problems at the intersection of finance, technology, and data. You'll have the chance to work on creative projects like the Stripe Assistant and the Stripe Foundation Model, which leverage machine learning to revolutionize how businesses interact with financial services and data.
Responsibilities
Develop and deploy large-scale machine learning systems that drive significant business value across various domains.
Engage in the end-to-end process of designing, training, improving, and launching machine learning models.
Write production-scale ML models that will be deployed to help Stripe enable economic infrastructure access for a diverse range of businesses globally.
Collaborate across teams to incorporate feedback and proactively seek solutions to challenges.
Rapidly learn new technologies and approaches, demonstrating a strong ability to ask insightful questions and communicate the status of your work effectively.
Who you are
Minimum requirements
A deep understanding of computer science, obtained through the pursuit of a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related field, with the expectation of graduating in winter 2027 or spring/summer 2028.
Practical experience with programming and machine learning, evidenced by projects, classwork, or research. Familiarity with languages such as Python, Scala, Spark and libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
Expertise in areas of machine learning such as supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, ML operations, and possibly experience in Large Language Models or Reinforcement Learning.
Demonstrated ability to work on collaborative projects, with experience in receiving and applying feedback from various stakeholders.
A proactive approach to learning unfamiliar systems and a demonstrated ability to understand complex systems independently.
Intent to return to the degree-program after the completion of the internship/co-op.
Preferred qualifications
You Might Also Have:
Two years of university education or equivalent experience, with in-depth knowledge in specific domains of machine learning.
Published and presented peer-reviewed articles in top-tier venues.
Experience in writing high-quality pull requests, maintaining good test coverage, and completing projects with minimal defects.
Familiarity with navigating new codebases and managing work across different programming languages.
Excellent written communication skills to clearly articulate your work to both team members and wider Stripe audiences.
Application requirements
Please submit the following with your application:
A detailed resume or LinkedIn profile showcasing your work history.
Examples of relevant work and your approach to learning, such as GitHub repositories, StackOverflow contributions, or other project portfolios.
Join us for an unforgettable summer internship and help shape the future of global commerce. At Stripe, you won't just be working on theoretical projects; you'll make a tangible impact on the world's economic infrastructure.

description:

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
